title: RiskBound: Risk-Aware Boundary-Guided Portfolio Optimization via Action Space Reshaping

problem.claim: Portfolio optimization seeks to make periodic asset allocation decisions that maximize long-term returns under risk.

gap.claim: Effective portfolio construction remains challenging because of time-varying, asset-level risk arising from non-stationary market dynamics.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper asks how to build portfolios robust to shifting market regimes and time-varying risk exposure.
Portfolio optimization involves periodic asset allocation to maximize long-term returns under risk.
Deep reinforcement learning has been effective for sequential portfolio decision-making.
Non-stationary, time-varying asset-level risk complicates portfolio construction, and mishandling it can cause compounding losses and severe long-horizon drawdowns.

unknowns: The proposed method and its specific mechanism are not described.
No experiments, datasets, baselines, metrics, or quantitative results are provided.
No theoretical analysis or reproducibility details are provided.
